# @@ print text and values
name = "Ada"
count = 3
print("hello,", name)
print("count:", fmt(count + 0.0, "d"))
print("a, b, c")
# @@ the full digits of a float
x = 2.0 / 3.0
print(fmt(x))
print("x =", fmt(x))
print("x=", fmt(x), sep="")
# @@ six significant digits
print(fmt(x, "g"))
print(fmt(1e-07, "g"), fmt(123456789.0, "g"))
# @@ a format per value
print("x =", fmt(x, ".3f"))
print("x =", fmt(x, ".3e"))
print("[", fmt(x, "10.4f"), "]", sep="")
print("count = ", fmt(count + 0.0, "d"), ", padded = [", fmt(count + 0.0, "4d"), "]", sep="")
# @@ strings in quotes
word = "it's"
print(repr(word))
print(repr(word), "has", fmt((len(word)) + 0.0, "d"), "characters")
# @@ build a line piece by piece
line = ""
for i to count {
    line = line + (fmt(i + 0.0, "d") + " ")
}
print(rstrip(line))
# @@ checks
if not (fmt(x, ".2f") == "0.67") {
    stop("AssertionError")
}
if not (fmt(0.5) == "0.5") {
    stop("AssertionError")
}
